# LPIS parcels for Ireland

Ireland (LPIS) field boundaries (2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2025) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Department of Agriculture, Food and the Marine. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ie_lpis/latest/ie_lpis.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ie_lpis/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:2157; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: eligible_area, claimed_area, hcat:name, commonage, hcat:code, metrics:area, geometry, crop:name, crop:code, id, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ie_lpis/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ie_lpis/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ie_lpis/collection.json
